name: speaker
meaning: object whose talk/idle animations follow the dialogue; set from Cine_SetDialogueParams or found via msg 0x58 on a selector-2 track

name: idleAnim
meaning: anim played once 2 s have passed since the page began

name: talkAnim
meaning: anim played during the first 2 s of a dialogue page and at dialogue start

name: camSetup
meaning: {u16 focal; u16 rot[3]; Vec3s pos} passed to Camera_StartScripted when dialogue mode starts
